title: Sort Increasing-Decreasing Array
statement:
Sort values presented as alternating monotonic runs.

Contract
- `values` is non-null and may be empty. It is a concatenation of runs whose direction alternates, starting nondecreasing.
- Return all values in ascending order in a new array and do not mutate the input.
- Negative values and duplicates are allowed.

Examples
- `[1, 4, 9, 8, 3, 2, 6, 7]` returns `[1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9]`.
- `[5, 4, 4, 1]` returns `[1, 4, 4, 5]`.
hints: Turn each monotonic run into an ascending sorted run.
Reverse the decreasing runs before merging.
Merge the sorted runs with a heap. Intended complexity: O(n log r) time for r runs.
inputSyntax: Input: an integer array, for example: [1, 4, 9, 8, 3, 2, 6, 7]
